home.title: Your music, one click away
home.body: Home brings your music services, Sonos favorites and recently played music together on one screen.

search.title: Search all your music services
search.body: Find songs, albums, artists and playlists on Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube Music, TIDAL and Sonos Radio, and play them on your speakers.

favorites.title: Your Sonos favorites on the big screen
favorites.body: Browse and play the favorites you saved in the Sonos app, and save new ones from Now Playing.

sound.title: Tune your sound from the couch
sound.body: EQ, loudness, night mode, speech enhancement, height audio, and sub and surround settings.

lyrics.title: Sing along with synced lyrics
lyrics.body: Time-synced lyrics next to the album art, line by line.

free: Picking a room, Now Playing, play, pause, skip, volume and TV Autoplay stay free.

features.title: Everything in Pro
features.search: Search Apple Music, Spotify and your other services
features.home: Home, Favorites and Jump Back In
features.lyrics: Synced lyrics and the Up Next queue
features.sound: Sound settings: EQ, sub, surround and more
features.future: Every feature that comes next, at no extra cost

footnote: One-time purchase, no subscription. Remos relies on interfaces Sonos doesn't document, so a Sonos update can break a feature until Remos is updated.
